newsitem.title: USA: Network Peripherals gets new CFO, other executives.
newsitem.headline: Network Peripherals gets new CFO, other executives.

text.p: Network Peripherals Inc said Wednesday it appointed a new chief financial officer and two other senior executives.

The maker of computer networking gear said it named Robert Hersh, former finance chief of SEEQ Technology Inc, as its CFO. Charles Hart, a former executive with InsWeb Corp, also was named executive vice president of business development. And Ramesh Neelmegh, the former head of engineering at Hybrid Networks, became vice president of engineering. Hersh replaced Truman Cole, who left Network Peripherals to pursue other interests.
